title: Grade 4
blurb: Unit-by-unit practice for the whole Grade 4 year — numbers to 10 000, the four operations, first fractions, shapes and symmetry, measurement and data, with a separate problem set for every unit.

units.title: Numbers to 10 000
units.blurb: Place value to the thousands, reading and writing numbers, comparing, rounding and number patterns.

units.title: Addition & Subtraction
units.blurb: Column addition and subtraction with regrouping, mental strategies, missing numbers and word problems.

units.title: Times Tables & Multiplication
units.blurb: Equal groups, the tables to ten, arrays and the turnaround trick, and multiplying bigger numbers.

units.title: Division & Sharing
units.blurb: Sharing and grouping, division facts, remainders and what they mean, halving, and choosing the operation.

units.title: Fractions — Parts of a Whole
units.blurb: Equal parts, unit and non-unit fractions, comparing fractions, equivalence and a fraction of a set.

units.title: Shapes & Symmetry
units.blurb: Naming 2-D shapes, right angles, sorting quadrilaterals, lines of symmetry, 3-D solids and perimeter.

units.title: Measurement, Time & Money
units.blurb: Centimetres and metres, grams and kilograms, millilitres and litres, the clock, the calendar and tögrög.

units.title: Data & Pictographs
units.blurb: Tally marks, tables and totals, pictograph keys, bar-chart scales and asking questions of data.
